Amazon Music doesn\'t let other apps read your library. To bring a song or album over, open it in Amazon Music, tap Share and choose Shiny — or type its name here.
Amazon doesn\'t show what\'s behind its links to other apps. Share it from the Amazon Music app to Shiny instead, or type the song\'s name.
Sign in to sync your YouTube Music library, likes and playlists. Your sign-in stays on this phone.

Bring your Spotify playlists and liked songs into Shiny. Each song is matched on YouTube Music.
Signed up with Google or Facebook? Type that email address and ask Spotify for a login code.

%1$s blocks its sign-in page inside other apps (“This browser or app may not be secure”), so it can\'t work here. Your Spotify account still can: on Spotify\'s login page, enter the email address you use with %1$s and choose to get a 6-digit login code.
Log In with an Email Code
On a computer where you\'re logged in to open.spotify.com, copy the value of the sp_dc cookie (browser DevTools → Application → Cookies) and paste it here. It stays on this phone.
